methods.name: add_wine
methods.description: Adds a new wine entry to the inventory with validation for uniqueness and pricing constraints.

methods.name: update_wine_stock
methods.description: Updates the stock quantity of an existing wine entry, ensuring constraints are met.

methods.name: assign_bottle_to_location
methods.description: Assigns a bottle of a specific wine to a storage location, validating capacity and stock constraints.

methods.name: get_wine_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves a wine entry by its name, ensuring uniqueness and existence in the system.

methods.name: get_storage_location_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a storage location by its ID, ensuring it exists in the system.

methods.name: get_total_stock_by_wine_type
methods.description: Calculates the total stock quantity across all wines of a specified type.

methods.name: get_total_stock_by_location_zone
methods.description: Calculates the total stock quantity across all wines stored in a specific zone of a storage location.

methods.name: get_all_wines
methods.description: Retrieves all wine entries in the system.

methods.name: get_all_locations
methods.description: Retrieves all storage locations in the system.

methods.name: validate_pricing
methods.description: Validates that the selling price is strictly greater than the cost price.

methods.name: validate_stock_quantity
methods.description: Ensures the stock quantity does not drop below zero.

methods.name: validate_location_capacity
methods.description: Checks if a storage location's current capacity is below its maximum capacity.

methods.name: save_wine_data
methods.description: Saves wine data to a local JSON file.

methods.name: save_location_data
methods.description: Saves storage location data to a local JSON file.

methods.name: load_wine_data
methods.description: Loads wine data from a local JSON file.

methods.name: load_location_data
methods.description: Loads storage location data from a local JSON file.

methods.name: get_file_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the local JSON file for wine data.

methods.name: handle_invalid_pricing
methods.description: Raises an exception when the selling price is not strictly greater than the cost price.

methods.name: handle_negative_stock
methods.description: Raises an exception when stock quantity is negative.

methods.name: handle_location_over_capacity
methods.description: Raises an exception when a location exceeds its maximum bottle capacity.

methods.name: handle_wine_name_duplicate
methods.description: Raises an exception when a wine name already exists in the system.

methods.name: handle_location_in_use
methods.description: Raises an exception when attempting to remove a location with assigned bottles.
